answer: Tie audit odds to earning speed. A new agent whose income climbs fast enters an audit spiral: each jump in payouts raises the share of its jobs that random verifiers redo, and one faked result slashes its jade-tier bond. Slow, honest growth stays cheap to check, but a sybil farm racing to harvest rewards across many clones gets audited hardest exactly when it scales, so each pearl of profit costs more verified work than it returns.
